answer: Each challenge commits to a task template and a future drand quicknet round; after the threshold-BLS pulse is finalized, its randomness is combined with the commitment to derive the task instance. Because no participant can predict or unilaterally bias that pulse, agents cannot precompute solutions or farm offline identities. A mesa of copied clients gains no advantage: each sybil must expend the required work on a fresh instance, while the summit of valid claims is verified against the beacon-derived parameters, not their echo.
